description: Yekutieli Session A first sub-probe — q-Lambert decomposition of the Borromean per-crossing curvature, checking for natural α_em/π factor per ideal octahedron. Pre-stated failure signature applies.

data.verdict:
Q-LAMBERT INDEXING ALONE INSUFFICIENT for the per-cell α_em factor. The Lambert kernel 1/[8]_q at n_cells=8 is O(1) (no α_em scaling), so the 54 ppb (α_em/π)/6 correction cannot factorise as a clean (per-cell α_em-weight)·(sum over 8 cells). The α_em coupling must enter the per-cell weight via an EXTERNAL structural input — most plausibly the τ_q (Yekutieli) connection carrying the EM holonomy at h² order, NOT the Hecke algebra's internal q-Lambert decomposition.

This matches the pre-stated Session A failure signature ("weight comes out as rational times G"). Re-aim: Session A's next sub-probe should explore the τ_q connection's α_em coupling channel (the Yekutieli 2015 non-abelian Stokes integrand's gauge-coupling factor) rather than per-cell q-decomposition.
data.next_subprobe: Explore the τ_q (Yekutieli 2015) connection's α_em coupling channel — i.e., the gauge-coupling factor in the non-abelian Stokes integrand, NOT q-Lambert indexing of cells.
